exposure: position in utero (first-born vs second-born twin)
outcome: admissions to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
finding: The study found significant differences between first-born and second-born twins in weight, size for gestational age, Apgar scores, and the total number of disorders and procedures they underwent, with chorionicity, conception mode, and maternal age being influential factors.
mod_finding: More cesarean sections were found in second-born twins, while first-born twins experienced more assisted vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Average 2,097g for first-born and 2,060g for second-born twins.
gest_age: Gestational age was considered, with 14.5% of first-born and 20.1% of second-born twins being small for gestational age.
